One of the major shortcomings of Cenk Cangır’s class is the absence of a comprehensive syllabus. A syllabus plays a crucial role in setting expectations and providing a roadmap for the course. Unfortunately, Cenk Cangır failed to provide a clear syllabus at the beginning of the semester, leaving students in a state of confusion and uncertainty. As a result, it was challenging for students to anticipate the topics to be covered and adequately prepare for assignments and exams. Throughout the semester, Cenk Cangır exhibited a disconcerting tendency to neglect his responsibility to provide clear guidance to his students. Despite attending every class session, students were left to fend for themselves when it came to understanding course material. Mr Cangır rarely offered explanations or clarifications, assuming that students were already familiar with the content. This lack of guidance made it exceedingly difficult for students to grasp the concepts being taught and hindered their ability to perform well academically. Perhaps one of the most distressing aspects of Mr Cangır’s teaching methodology is his apparent reliance on subjective grading practices. It is disheartening to note that grades were seemingly assigned based on personal feelings rather than objective assessment criteria. Multiple students reported instances where they received significantly lower grades than they believed they deserved. This inconsistent and biased approach to grading not only undermines the credibility of the evaluation process but also impairs the students' motivation to excel academically. In addition to the aforementioned issues, it is regrettable to note that Cenk Cangır consistently failed to demonstrate an understanding and empathetic attitude towards his students. Despite attending every single class session, students were often met with impatience and dismissive responses when seeking clarifications or requesting additional support.
